Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Solo TTRPG & Journaling RPG Play Aids
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo tabletop roleplayers (active on Reddit, Itch.io, Kickstarter) who play games like Ironsworn, Thousand Year Old Vampire, or Colostle. They buy physical journals, prompts, oracle decks, and play mats to enhance immersion.
product_angles: Physical 'Oracle' card decks for prompt generation on TGC
proposals.first_test_product: A 54-card 'Sci-Fi Sector Generator' Oracle Deck on TGC with abstract vector icons

proposals.name: Eurorack Modular Synthesizer Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Music producers, engineers, and DIY hardware geeks who build modular synth systems. They have high disposable income, love cyberpunk/brutalist aesthetics, and obsess over cable management and front panel designs.
product_angles: 3D printable Eurorack blank panels with geometric designs (Cults3D)
Eurorack patch cable hangers & desktop stand STL files
proposals.first_test_product: Pack of 5 brutalist-style 3D-printable Eurorack blank panels (8HP, 10HP, 12HP) on Cults3D

proposals.name: Aquascaping & Dwarf Shrimp Breeders
proposals.buyer_persona: Aquarists focused on miniature planted tanks and breeding high-grade dwarf shrimp (Neocaridina/Caridina). They need exact water chemistry logs and specialized breeding caves or plant feeding ledges.
product_angles: Water parameter tracking notebook with shrimp feeding calendars (KDP)
3D printed modular moss ledges and feeding dishes (Cults3D - PETG safe)
Minimalist line-art posters of specific shrimp morphs (Etsy/Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: 3D-printable suction-cup moss ledge and shrimp cave pack on Cults3D

proposals.name: Amateur Astrophotography Logbooks & Rig Accessories
proposals.buyer_persona: Night sky photographers who spend hours capturing deep-space nebulae. They need precise logs for gear setups, target coordinates, exposure calculations, and weather conditions, plus cable management for their complex telescope rigs.
product_angles: Deep Sky Object (DSO) imaging logbook with calibration frame checklists (KDP)
3D-printable Bahtinov focusing masks customized for popular lens sizes (Cults3D)
Telescope counterweight and cable organizer clips
proposals.first_test_product: An astrophotography session planner and data logbook on Amazon KDP

proposals.name: B2B Craft Brewery Merch & Vector Label Kits
proposals.buyer_persona: Independent craft brewery owners and graphic designers looking for fast, high-quality vector assets to build beer labels, coasters, and taproom merchandise templates.
product_angles: Gothic/Psychedelic vector asset bundles for can labels (Etsy/Creative Market)
Customizable local craft beer coaster templates (SVG/Canva links)
proposals.first_test_product: Psychedelic & Retro-mascot vector design kit (SVG/PNG) for craft beer labels

proposals.name: Urbex & Speleology (Caving) Gear & Logs
proposals.buyer_persona: Urban explorers (Urbex) and cavers who document abandoned structures and cave networks. They value safety protocols, gear lists, mapping, and possess a strong dark/grungy sub-culture identity.
product_angles: Urbex exploration logbook with safety checklists and location sketchpads (KDP)
Sarcastic 'cave squeeze' test templates and caving humor apparel (Redbubble)
3D printable rugged SD card / battery cases for action cameras (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: The 'Urbex Expedition Log & Site Hazard Assessment Notebook' on Amazon KDP
